idea-plugin.name: ShipLens
idea-plugin.description:
A lens from git blame to release version. See which release first shipped any line of code, right in your IDE.

The status bar shows the first release tag that contains the line under your cursor — answering the question "in which release did this line first reach users?" without leaving the editor.

  • Single status-bar item, updates as the cursor moves.
  • Tooltip with commit SHA, summary, author, and tag date.
  • Configurable tag include/exclude globs (pre-releases filtered by default).
  • Graceful degradation for Uncommitted, Unreleased, and Limited history.

Same algorithm as the VSCode/Cursor edition.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.2 — initial JetBrains release

First release on the JetBrains Marketplace, with feature parity to the VSCode/Cursor edition at version 0.1.2. Both editions will advance together going forward.

  • Status-bar widget showing the first release tag for the line under the cursor.
  • Tooltip with commit SHA, summary, author, and tag date.
  • Tag include/exclude glob configuration. Defaults exclude common pre-release patterns plus the rescue/* namespace some teams use for internal hotfixes.
  • Graceful degradation for Uncommitted, Unreleased, and Limited history states.
  • Settings UI under Settings → Tools → ShipLens.
  • Plugin icon mirroring the VSCode edition.
